items.quote: a designation officially changed in 1982 to the "Emerald City"
The Pike Place Fish Market is widely known for its custom of hurling customers' orders across the shopping area
items.note: Strictly the fish throwing is Pike Place Fish Market, a stall inside Pike Place Market; accept either.

items.quote: Johnny Allen Hendrix was born on November 27, 1942, in Seattle
items.note: Born Johnny Allen Hendrix, renamed James Marshall in 1946. Purple Haze was a 1967 Jimi Hendrix Experience single (same article).

items.quote: The mountain is located in Mount Rainier National Park about 59 mi south-southeast of Seattle
Grunge (originally known as the Seattle Sound) is an alternative rock genre
items.note: Some may say 'alternative rock', the parent genre; grunge is the specific answer. Nirvana formed in Aberdeen, not Seattle, but the question says 'associated with'.

items.quote: Frasier hosts The Dr. Frasier Crane Show, a call-in psychiatry show on talk radio station, KACL
items.note: The 2023 Paramount+ revival moved Frasier to Boston; the question's past tense still holds.

items.quote: under the north end of the George Washington Memorial Bridge (also known as the Aurora Bridge)
items.note: Accept George Washington Memorial Bridge, its official name.

items.quote: Seattle is situated on an isthmus between Puget Sound, an inlet of the Pacific Ocean, and Lake Washington
items.note: Rechecked after rewording; the question now tracks the article almost word for word. Elliott Bay is an inlet of Puget Sound rather than of the Pacific, and the Salish Sea is not an inlet, so one answer.

items.quote: The Seattle Mariners are an American professional baseball team based in Seattle
